title: Polish Bridge UI v2: compact Project Router + Bridge Chat
description: GitHub main is the source of truth. Sync the latest machxanht/BridgeChatgpt main including ProjectRouterV2.tsx, BridgeChatPanel.tsx, and WorkspaceView.tsx. Preserve the routing/data logic already implemented; this task is primarily visual polish plus integration validation. Requirements: (1) Project Router should show existing projects as compact switcher cards/chips; selected project must be clearly green ACTIVE. (2) The 3-field new-project form must stay collapsed behind a single Add Project button until opened. (3) For the active project, repo + AI Studio session(s) + ChatGPT session(s) must be presented in one compact module with Open/Edit/Save actions, editable labels/session names and URLs, mobile/tablet-first layout. (4) Switching project must feel instant like a router: preserve active workspace locally, immediately swap project detail and Bridge Chat routing without page reload, and keep project-scoped target selection. (5) Bridge Chat is the primary work area: human messages remain visible in the feed; ChatGPT/Studio handoffs/results tied to project tasks appear in the same feed; auto route prefers ChatGPT lead and exact target selection remains available. (6) Keep low-level Mission Control/task/log controls collapsed under a single system-details disclosure; remove/reduce duplicated clutter on the main screen. (7) Use tasteful icons, status colors, subtle animation/pulse/spinner transitions, good spacing and hierarchy; avoid text-dense cards. Do not redesign backend semantics or remove Wake/Resource Router behavior. Do not expose secrets or private chat content in GitHub. Run npm run lint, npm test, npm run build, and production startup smoke. Fix only real defects discovered. If checks pass, Publish the updated Bridge deployment. After Publish, re-register this exact Studio target if registry reset and send Studio Relay heartbeat. Report what UI changed and any remaining limitations. GitHub baseline already passed CI before this task.
